# LayersDescriptor

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent builder for the `Layers` inline z-stacking primitive, used by `Container.Layers(...)`. Layers paint in declaration order: background behind, the primary layer in the middle (it defines the flow height), and foreground on top.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new LayersDescriptor()
```

## Methods

- [`Background`](#background): Adds a layer painted behind the primary layer.
- [`Foreground`](#foreground): Adds a layer painted on top of the primary layer.
- [`PrimaryLayer`](#primarylayer): Sets the primary content layer - the layer that determines the flow height of the stack.

### `Background`

```csharp
LayersDescriptor Background(IElement element)
```

Adds a layer painted behind the primary layer.

### `Foreground`

```csharp
LayersDescriptor Foreground(IElement element)
```

Adds a layer painted on top of the primary layer.

### `PrimaryLayer`

```csharp
LayersDescriptor PrimaryLayer(IElement element)
```

Sets the primary content layer - the layer that determines the flow height of the stack.
